theory: Step 4 incorrectly allows taking the absolute value of an entire half-integral before doubling when the function changes sign within that half. State that, for an odd or even function, the area on one half must first be calculated by splitting at its intercepts and adding the absolute values of the resulting sub-integrals, then doubled; the booklet requires this splitting at lines 132–164. Also qualify the parity integral identities as applying when the function is integrable throughout the symmetric interval.
